name: Thorismund
contribution: Killed in the Battle of the Catalaunian Plains in 451 AD. He was murdered in 453 and was succeeded by his brother Theodoric II.

checks.lead: Thorismund (Gothic: 𐌸𐌰𐌿𐍂𐌹𐍃𐌼𐍉𐌸, also Thorismond, Thorismod or Thorismud, as manuscripts of the chief source confusingly attest) (c. 420–453), became king of the Visigoths after his father Theodoric I was killed in the Battle of the Catalaunian Plains (also called Battle of Châlons) in 451 AD. He was murdered in 453 and was succeeded by his brother Theodoric II.
